entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Multiple shots rang out loudly. The..."
entries.dialogueText:
Multiple shots rang out loudly. The guard to your right fell to the ground; the one on the left leapt to shield you.

You felt a sudden, sharp impact to your chest. You collapsed on the ground.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You knew. You knew that from the..."
entries.dialogueText:
You knew.

You knew that from the moment you held up that gun, your fate would be sealed. Yet, you could not help yourself.

It was because of...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the exchange of gunfire intensif..."
entries.dialogueText:
As the exchange of gunfire intensified, dozens of bullets found their way into your vehicle, creating holes wherever they hit.

You felt two sudden, sharp impacts to your chest. The pain was immediate.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You looked down at your body."
entries.dialogueText: You looked down at your body.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...revenge."
entries.dialogueText: ...revenge.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The shot rang out loudly. You felt..."
entries.dialogueText:
The shot rang out loudly. You felt a heavy impact to your chest.

The pain was immediate. You collapsed on the ground.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Multiple shots rang out loudly. You..."
entries.dialogueText:
Multiple shots rang out loudly. You tried to dodge the bullets as they whizzed past.

You felt two sharp impacts to your chest. You collapsed on the ground.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The fabric of your shirt had turned..."
entries.dialogueText:
The fabric of your shirt had turned a deep red.

Blood was pooling beneath you.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...tried to stop the bleeding."
entries.dialogueText: ...tried to stop the bleeding.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...knew this was the end."
entries.dialogueText: ...knew this was the end.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...looked around for help."
entries.dialogueText: ...looked around for help.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You could see vague silhouettes rus..."
entries.dialogueText:
You could see vague silhouettes rushing towards you, but you couldn't identify who they were.

The adrenaline left your body, giving way to radiating pain. Your view was becoming hazy, your breath shallow.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You accepted your fate. The adre..."
entries.dialogueText:
You accepted your fate.

The adrenaline left your body, giving way to radiating pain. Your view was becoming hazy, your breath shallow.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You could not find the strength to..."
entries.dialogueText:
You could not find the strength to move forward.

The adrenaline left your body, giving way to radiating pain. Your view was becoming hazy, your breath shallow.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...were proud of what you had manag..."
entries.dialogueText: ...were proud of what you had managed to accomplish in life.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...wished you could start all over..."
entries.dialogueText: ...wished you could start all over again.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...felt as if a heavy burden had be..."
entries.dialogueText: ...felt as if a heavy burden had been lifted.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...the most beautiful thing you had..."
entries.dialogueText: ...the most beautiful thing you had ever seen.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...not worth dying for."
entries.dialogueText: ...not worth dying for.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...just a piece of cloth."
entries.dialogueText: ...just a piece of cloth.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And so passed His Majesty, Romus of..."
entries.dialogueText: And so passed His Majesty, Romus of House Toras.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The second-to-last of his name."
entries.dialogueText: The second-to-last of his name.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...dignity."
entries.dialogueText: ...dignity.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...pride."
entries.dialogueText: ...pride.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You felt your body violently jerked..."
entries.dialogueText:
You felt your body violently jerked around by a hail of bullets.

You collapsed on the ground.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You had but a single moment. One la..."
entries.dialogueText:
You had but a single moment. One last act.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...charged the attackers."
entries.dialogueText: ...charged the attackers.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...spit on the ground."
entries.dialogueText: ...spit on the ground.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...demanded they kneel before their..."
entries.dialogueText: ...demanded they kneel before their King.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You blinked and you were a child ag..."
entries.dialogueText:
You blinked and you were a child again, running through the palace gardens. You were holding up a Rizian flag, its colors bold against the blue sky.

In your last moments, you thought it was...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The force of the impact was unlike..."
entries.dialogueText:
The force of the impact was unlike anything you had ever experienced, a concussive wave that tore through metal and flesh with indiscriminate fury.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...prayed."
entries.dialogueText: ...prayed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...let yourself go."
entries.dialogueText: ...let yourself go.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Inside the car, the world turned up..."
entries.dialogueText:
Inside the car, the world turned upside down. 

You were momentarily suspended in a maelstrom of shattering glass, twisting metal, and the piercing screams of your guards.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...tried to grab onto anything you..."
entries.dialogueText: ...tried to grab onto anything you could find.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The APC fired again."
entries.dialogueText: The APC fired again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A searing, all-consuming blaze took..."
entries.dialogueText:
A searing, all-consuming blaze took hold of you.

Lying there, the sounds of battle receding like the tide, you were enveloped in a profound solitude.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...hoped that it would be over quic..."
entries.dialogueText: ...hoped that it would be over quickly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...knew this was the end."
entries.dialogueText: ...knew this was the end.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...looked around for help."
entries.dialogueText: ...looked around for help.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was no one to help you. Th..."
entries.dialogueText:
There was no one to help you.

The surge of adrenaline faded, giving way to radiating pain. Your view was becoming hazy, your breath shallow.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You accepted your fate. The surg..."
entries.dialogueText:
You accepted your fate.

The surge of adrenaline faded, giving way to radiating pain. Your view was becoming hazy, your breath shallow.

You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You could not find the strength to..."
entries.dialogueText:
You could not find the strength to move forward.

The surge of adrenaline faded, giving way to radiating pain. Your view was becoming hazy, your breath shallow.

You...

entries.title: Jump from Kingdom Dissolves to Death

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The last of his name."
entries.dialogueText: The last of his name.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You blinked and you were a child ag..."
entries.dialogueText:
You blinked and you were a child again, running through the forests of Brenas. You were holding up a Rizian flag, its colors bold against the greenery.

In your last moments, you thought it was...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You blinked and you were a child ag..."
entries.dialogueText:
You blinked and you were a child again, running on the Zille beach. You were holding up a Rizian flag, its colors bold against the blue sky.

In your last moments, you thought it was...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...could almost hear Lena and Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: ...could almost hear Lena and Vina calling to you.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...could almost hear Lena calling t..."
entries.dialogueText: ...could almost hear Lena calling to you.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...could almost hear Vina calling t..."
entries.dialogueText: ...could almost hear Vina calling to you.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You blinked and suddenly found your..."
entries.dialogueText:
You blinked and suddenly found yourself engulfed by a dazzling light. 

A shining golden pillar appeared before you, stretching up to the heavens. Leading the way to Golconda.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...did not deserve it."
entries.dialogueText: ...did not deserve it.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...ascended to a realm of eternal b..."
entries.dialogueText: ...ascended to a realm of eternal bliss.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...were hallucinating as your brain..."
entries.dialogueText: ...were hallucinating as your brain lost oxygen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pain shot through your body, but yo..."
entries.dialogueText:
Pain shot through your body, but you forced yourself to remain standing. 

And then another shot rang out, and your legs immediately gave out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lying there on the floor, through y..."
entries.dialogueText: Lying there on the floor, through your fading consciousness, you could see Vina and your mother hiding under a nearby table, fear in their eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lying there on the floor, through y..."
entries.dialogueText: Lying there on the floor, through your fading consciousness, you could see your mother hiding under a nearby table, fear in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With great effort, you turned aroun..."
entries.dialogueText: With great effort, you turned around to see Lucita holding a rifle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With great effort, you turned aroun..."
entries.dialogueText: With great effort, you turned around to see Hugo standing next to an armed Toras house guard.

entries.dialogueText: You tried to locate the source of the shots.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With great effort, you turned aroun..."
entries.dialogueText: With great effort, you turned around to see armed guards looking at you.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It was over."
entries.dialogueText: It was over.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You collapsed to the ground as angr..."
entries.dialogueText: You collapsed to the ground as angry faces and furious voices closed in around you.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As everything faded to black, you r..."
entries.dialogueText: As everything faded to black, you realized you would never again see your mother or daughter.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As everything faded to black, you r..."
entries.dialogueText: As everything faded to black, you realized you would never see your mother or Vina again -- let alone witness the birth of your second child.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You realized then that you would ne..."
entries.dialogueText: You realized then that you would never see your mother or Vina, or hold Pabel in your arms ever again.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It was over."
entries.dialogueText: It was over.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo pulled out a pistol and shot..."
entries.dialogueText:
Adarfo pulled out a pistol and shot you in the gut. 

You collapsed clutching the wound as blood seeped through your fingers.

You screamed...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You’ll burn for this!""
entries.dialogueText: "You’ll burn for this!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Shooting an unarmed man... Where i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shooting an unarmed man... Where is your honor?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've made your point! I won't ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've made your point! I won't cause any more trouble. Just take me to a hospital!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I should have never trusted you!""
entries.dialogueText: "I should have never trusted you!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your vision blurred as Adarfo left..."
entries.dialogueText: Your vision blurred as Adarfo left you bleeding, alone.
